method.school: NIT Northern Institute of Technology Management

cost_tracking.note: Manual Codex extraction pass; standalone LLM/API token and cost telemetry was not exposed.

workflow: Read required repo documentation and v0.2 prompt/schema contract.
Used NIT v0.3 and v0.4 crawler files as candidate recall surfaces only.
Live-read official NIT programme and admissions pages to confirm programme grouping and requirements.
Kept Technology Management as one programme family with degree/ECTS variants rather than separate single/double-degree top-level records.
Rejected unscoped GRE/GMAT/German requirements where official NIT evidence did not make them applicable to all NIT programmes.
limitations: NIT admissions page mixes Technology Management single-degree and double-degree instructions with Business Analytics & AI; applicant-route scope remains important.
Double-degree TUHH MSc requirements are partly delegated to TUHH pages and are not exhaustively extracted here.
Application dates on programme pages and admissions page differ by route; this file records both route-specific date ranges with review notes.
method.format_note: Matches the repo v0.3 LLM-native contract with v0.2 gap-repair method metadata.

school.name: NIT Northern Institute of Technology Management
NIT Northern Institute of Technology Management

program.name: Technology Management
program.degree: Master of Business Administration or Master of Arts
program.specialization: single-degree and double-degree routes; 90 or 120 ECTS variants

academic_background.degree_level: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Natural Science, Information or Computer Science for double degree; Engineering, Natural Science, Information or Computer Science or a business-related field for single degree.
academic_background.minimum_grade: Good grades in the upper third to quarter
notes: Applicants need a proven record of personal and academic achievement.
Double-degree applicants must also satisfy the selected TUHH MSc programme requirements.

subject_prerequisites.subject: Engineering, Natural Science, Information or Computer Science

language_requirements.test: Cambridge Certificate in Advanced English or Proficiency in English
telc English C1 or DAAD Language Certificate

test_requirements.notes: Admissions committee uses supplied documents and a personal interview; promising candidates may be interviewed in person or via Zoom/Teams.

work_experience.relevance: Initial professional experience is a plus but not required for admission; 12 months relevant post-bachelor experience affects whether the Technology Management degree is MBA rather than M.A.
notes: Official page says initial professional experience is a plus but not an admission requirement.
Admissions page says 12 months relevant professional experience after the bachelor's degree is needed for the MBA title; otherwise graduates receive the M.A. in Technology Management.

documents: Bachelor's degree certificate or provisional certificate
Proof of work experience if applicable
conditional_paths: 90 ECTS or 120 ECTS Technology Management route
international_requirements: Applicants from China, Mongolia, Vietnam and India may need APS upon enrollment according to the admissions document checklist.
German TestDaF or DSH is required for TUHH MSc programmes taught in German, not for NIT's English-taught Technology Management coursework itself.

deadlines: Admissions page double master route: December 1 - March 1
Admissions page single degree / Business Analytics & AI route: October 1 - September 15
application.application_channel: NIT online application form; double-degree TUHH route integrated into TUHH application process

general.source_text: Official programme page identifies Master/MBA 90 ECTS and 120 ECTS variants, October 2025 start, MBA or M.A. degree, and 90/120 ECTS credit points.
general.review_note: Live official page read during v0.2 pass.

general.source_text: Official requirements say double-degree applicants need Engineering, Natural Science, Information or Computer Science; single-degree applicants may also have a business-related field; good grades, achievement record, high English proficiency, and professional experience as a plus.
general.review_note: Live official page read during v0.2 pass.

general.source_text: Admissions page lists English proof options including TOEFL 90 iBT / 577 paper-based, IELTS Academic 6.5, Cambridge CAE/CPE, telc English C1, and DAAD C1; admissions process uses documents and personal interview.
general.review_note: Live official admissions page read during v0.2 pass.

raw_evidence_sections.heading: The requirements to study at the NIT
raw_evidence_sections.text: Double Degree: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Natural Science, Information or Computer Science. Single Degree: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Natural Science, Information or Computer Science or in a business related field. Good grades in the upper third to quarter, proven record of personal and academic achievement, high level of proficiency in English, and initial professional experience as a plus but not required.

raw_evidence_sections.heading: Master in Technology Management overview
raw_evidence_sections.text: Master/MBA 90 ECTS and 120 ECTS routes; start October 2025; application period October 1, 2024 until September 31, 2025; degree Master of Business Administration or Master of Arts when work experience is less than one year; tuition Master 90 ECTS 26,750 EUR and Master 120 ECTS +9,750 EUR.

raw_evidence_sections.heading: Proof of English language proficiency and admission process
raw_evidence_sections.text: TOEFL 90 iBT or 577 paper-based, IELTS Academic 6.5, Cambridge Advanced/Proficiency, telc English C1, or DAAD C1; admission committee reviews supplied documents and a personal interview.

general.review_note: Live official page read during v0.2 pass.

general.review_note: Shared route evidence; date conflicts with programme page's 'application possible at any time'.

raw_evidence_sections.heading: The requirements to study Business Analytics & AI
raw_evidence_sections.text: Bachelor's or equivalent degree from a recognized university in engineering, science and technology, business engineering, business administration including business informatics, business mathematics and business geography, or economics; good previous academic performance; high level of English; at least one year of professional experience.

raw_evidence_sections.heading: Master in Business Analytics & AI overview
raw_evidence_sections.text: 120 ECTS full-time; start October 2026; application possible at any time; degree Master of Science conferred by TUHH; tuition EUR 7,437.50 per semester.

key_findings.finding: NIT should be represented as two programme families: Technology Management and Business Analytics & AI.
key_findings.impact: The v0.3 crawler's separate single-degree URL record is folded into the Technology Management family rather than duplicated.

key_findings.finding: Technology Management has single-degree/double-degree and 90/120 ECTS routes; these are variants within one programme family.
key_findings.impact: Degree and application fields preserve route distinctions in notes and conditional paths.

key_findings.finding: Crawler language extraction attached German DSH/TestDaF to NIT generally, but official admissions text scopes German proficiency to TUHH MSc programmes taught in German.
key_findings.impact: German is kept as an international/double-degree route note, not as a general NIT English-programme language requirement.

key_findings.finding: Business Analytics & AI is official-confirmed as a Master of Science with 120 ECTS, October 2026 start, one year professional experience, and EUR 7,437.50 per semester.
key_findings.impact: v0.2 keeps it as a full programme record with official evidence.

known_gaps.gap: Technology Management page says application period until September 31, 2025, which is not a valid calendar date but is preserved as official page text.
known_gaps.next_step: Human reviewer should verify the intended final September deadline with NIT.

known_gaps.gap: TUHH double-degree MSc admission conditions are delegated to TUHH pages and are not fully extracted here.
known_gaps.next_step: A route-aware extraction should attach TUHH MSc prerequisites separately from NIT Technology Management admissions.
